data.name: Pacorro
data.gender_notes: Pacorro is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek words 'pax' meaning peace and 'agoros' meaning shepherd or leader. Pacorro embodies the peaceful and caring nature of a shepherd, who guides and protects his flock. The name Pacorro carries the meaning “Peaceful shepherd” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Pacorro usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful shepherd and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name imbued with the peace of the Lord and the shepherding love of Christ.
data.etymology: Pacorro belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful shepherd.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pacorro total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

It signifies a leader or a figure of authority who instills a peaceable environment through his actions and demeanor. In different parts of the world, particularly in Christian communities, it is a name that resonates with the characteristics of Jesus Christ, who was often referred to as the Good Shepherd.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Pacorro represents the spiritual virtues of guidance, protection, and care. Pacorro is a name that evokes feelings of security and trust, emphasizing the spiritual connection between the individual and their belief in God as a loving and loving protector.
